decision_factorization.end_of_turn_definition: ASR-final or simulator TTS-playback-complete AND at least 400 ms acoustic silence
decision_factorization.speaker_personalisation_scope: frozen DistilHuBERT plus participant-specific replay head
decision_factorization.feedback_routing: context errors never update the acoustic personalisation head

initialization.network_update_control: Only the participant-specific head may update; the shared head and frozen speech backbone remain immutable.

personal_head_optimizer.selection_protocol: eight disjoint simulated development profiles; 200 ms voiced frames followed by real 200 ms silence frames; independent end-of-turn, addressee and reply-needed gates; at most one correction direction per opportunity

initialization.formal_lock_rule: Lock after the eight-profile engineering comparison and before the separate thirty-two-profile duration run.

absolute_tail_adequacy_gate.interpretation: predeclared engineering adequacy target, not a universal HCI standard

duration_simulation.primary_outcome: eligible manual activate plus interrupt corrections divided by eligible opportunities

interaction_cycle.manual_interrupt_rule: Interrupt only if the experimental agent responds to a no-reply primary turn or during companion dialogue. Any response before participant TTS completion is an end-of-turn gate failure, not a learnable negative example.
interaction_cycle.manual_activate_rule: After a reply-requesting primary turn, stream real zero-valued PCM in 200 ms frames for the frozen 1–3 second deadline; manually activate only if no valid response begins.
interaction_cycle.one_label_per_opportunity: A single opportunity may produce at most one correction direction. Context-attributed errors are quarantined from the acoustic personalisation head.
interaction_cycle.difficulty_balance: Every cycle has fixed intent, speaker-role, category and four low/four medium/four high lexical-length bands.

voice_design.selection_rule: Exclude every selection8 and duration32 participant speaker, then select the two agent speakers by maximin robust-standardized acoustic distance using F0, spectral centroid, rolloff, zero-crossing rate, RMS and eight spectral bands.

duration_simulation.scope: engineering simulation only; profiles, voices, utterances and tap events are not human participants
